title: Scathe for Godot 4 is live: battle damage drawn into your own sprites
html:
Scathe is live for Godot 4. Every hit leaves a mark of its kind on the sprite that took it, and the whole sprite wears down as its health falls. One canvas shader draws it all from your own sprite's pixels, inside its own outline, so there are no damaged variants to paint. 49 presets: 7 kinds of mark on 7 materials, shown on seven painted demo creatures you can keep.

What it does

  • The element name picks the mark. take_damage(amount, max_hp, "Fire Breath") lowers health and chars the sprite; ice frosts it, thunder burns a branching scar, poison bruises, earth cracks, acid pits and eats holes through it, anything else cuts.
  • The body decides how it lands. Flesh bleeds and runs, shell and stone chip to their bare material, metal scores bright and tempers under fire instead of charring, slime splits and blisters, spirit tears give light and fire burns straight through.
  • HP bands at 75%, 50% and 25%: the colour drains, the outline darkens, grime sinks in, then the outline takes bites. Healing lifts the wear and keeps the marks.
  • Each new mark lands on a part of the body thick enough to hold it, away from the others. A pixel grid setting keeps marks on the pixels of art drawn at 2x, 3x or 4x.

Tested

  • Every preset photographed under Forward+ and Compatibility: 98 frames, zero engine errors, each measured against its creature untouched and all 49 distinct.
  • The shipped zip installed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project under both renderers: a preset scene, a Sprite2D and a TextureRect, the whole API, every listed element word, the bands, the mark limit, and a check that no mark is ever drawn outside the sprite.
  • 8 attacks, including odd paths, fifty damaged creatures on screen at once, a third renderer and bad inputs; 126 Readme claims checked against the shipped files.

Free lite

The page carries a free MIT lite: cut, scorch, rime and blight on flesh, slime and spirit, twelve presets with the same node and demo.

Where this line stands: 18 Godot packs live from this studio, 1 purchase so far (read from the store the day this went live).

Disclosure: the shader, scripts and demo were written with AI, and the demo creatures and battleback were painted by an AI image model. The cover was rendered by the pack itself.
